request.style: English, deep male baritone with full gospel choir, acoustic piano, electric organ, tambourine, bass guitar, steady drums, uplifting and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The chariots of God are twice ten thousand
Thousands upon thousands in the holy place
The Lord is among them in the sanctuary
Sinai stands firm in the sacred space

[Pre-Chorus]
You ascended on high in your might
You led captives in your train
You received gifts among men
Even from the rebellious

[Chorus]
Blessed be the Lord who daily bears our burdens
The God of our salvation is here
Blessed be the Lord who daily bears our burdens
The God of our salvation is near

[Verse]
Our God is a God who saves us truly
From the Lord God comes escape from death
He crushes the heads of his enemies
The hairy crown of those in guilt

[Chorus]
Blessed be the Lord who daily bears our burdens
The God of our salvation is here
Blessed be the Lord who daily bears our burdens
The God of our salvation is near

[Bridge]
I will bring them back from Bashan high
I will bring them back from the depths of the sea
The Lord speaks and the world is set free

[Outro]
Blessed be the Lord who daily bears our burdens
The God of our salvation
